statusDefinitions.fully-supported: A node exists; the real client-to-normalizer flow credits exactly that node at the difficulty actually presented; Mixed Practice reaches the mode (or the lab has no Mixed).
statusDefinitions.metadata-repair-needed: Scoring and a node exist but the question does not send the metadata needed to reach the node correctly.
statusDefinitions.curriculum-mapping-needed: Scoring is objective and tested but no node exists. A teacher decision about the assessed skill is needed before a node is added.
statusDefinitions.scoring-validation-needed: A node could exist, but it has not been shown that the scoring measures one skill with one defensible correct response.
statusDefinitions.intentionally-practice-only: Stays available for practice. Counting it as first-attempt skill evidence would be misleading.
statusDefinitions.unsupported: The activity emits no evidence events to the student profile.

priorityDefinitions.medium: Worth scheduling; no wrong credit is being given.
priorityDefinitions.high: Wrong or missing credit for students today.

metadataVocabulary.practiceMode: sent = the event's assessed mode equals the question's own mode in every drawn question (never "mixed").
metadataVocabulary.family: sent-and-bound = every family id sent is bound to the node (narrowing active); sent-partly-unbound = some are not bound; sent-unbound = none are bound; not-sent = the page sends no family id. In the last three cases credit falls back to the mode selector, which is the credit measured here.
metadataVocabulary.difficulty: sent = the difficulty recorded equals the difficulty presented; not-applicable = the lab or mode has no difficulty levels.
